summary: Planet Green Holdings Corp. filed an 8-K on August 21, 2026 disclosing that Curvature Securities, LLC, as sales agent, delivered written notice terminating the parties' July 13, 2026 ATM Sales Agreement effective close of business August 24, 2026. No shares were sold under the agreement. The registrant is the issuer, not an acquirer, target, or seller, and the termination of an at-the-market equity distribution facility is a routine financing-relationship event rather than a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, premium, or closing condition are stated.
